item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
First release

  • RAM and CPU in the menu bar — system-wide usage, colored from green to red as the load rises.
  • Every process, one click away — CPU and memory per process, sorted by RAM or CPU, searchable by name or PID.
  • Quit what's eating your Mac — the ✕ quits a process; ⌥-click or right-click → Force Quit kills it.
  • Make it yours — RAM, CPU or both, text size, label and value colors, with a live preview.
  • This Mac — model, chip, CPU and GPU cores, memory, storage, macOS and uptime at a glance.
  • Featherweight — pure AppKit, ~13 MB at launch, near-zero CPU while the panel is closed.
